MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

4. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   B. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.

5. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   C. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.

9. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance.

10. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Red, blue, and yellow

2. B — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. B — Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. A — The speed of the music

7. D — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Singing Games; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Musical Instruments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Rhythm COMPOSING; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
